summary: ChipMOS filed a Form 6-K reporting shareholder approval of a cash dividend distribution of NT$1.23 per common share (approx. US$0.78 per ADS) from capital surplus, declared February 24, 2026, with ex-dividend date June 29, 2026, record date June 29, 2026, and distribution date July 24, 2026. The withholding tax rate decreased from 21% to 0% due to payout from capital surplus. This is a routine dividend announcement, not a special-situation event. The filing serves only as a notice to ADS holders via Nasdaq.
